system.description:
Only a creature with a feature that grants one (Combat Reflexes, or a monster ability that says so) makes Attacks of Opportunity; the feature says what provokes it, and Disengaging always prevents it. Being moved by someone else (a shove, a push, a throw) or teleporting never provokes one, unless the ability causing it says so.

Reactions. Only a feature that says it is a reaction (a class, kit or feat feature, or a monster ability) can be used out of turn: once per round unless it says otherwise, regained at the start of your turn.

  • Anything that stops reactions (Surprised, Incapacitated) stops these.
  • A feature that gives extra reactions says so, and those extras can only be used for that feature (the Swashbuckler's Second Flourish).

Press Use to spend your reaction for the round, then attack with your weapon.

activities.name: Attack of Opportunity
activities.text: Your reaction: one melee attack against a creature leaving your melee reach without Disengaging.
